desc: 云朵般柔软的磨毛四件套，深口袋床笠不滑脱，机洗不褪色全家用
name: 云朵软磨毛床品四件套款

shots.intent: 一图立住产品：垂坠褶皱加色彩货架感
亲肤耐用全家可用的情感场景
套装构成一次讲清：两枕套一平单一床笠带口袋深度
2x2 特写证明工艺：信封枕套、松紧床笠、深口袋、缎边平单
柔软如云的情感峰值：悬浮云海中的安睡场景
用玩耍证明柔软亲肤与家庭信任
直击打理焦虑：床品进洗衣机，四枚护理图标收底
色选收束：同一构图下的全色系面料阵列
电影感收尾：亲密家庭依偎加价值总结文案区

style.backgroundSystem: real bedrooms with warm white or warm sand walls #D4CFCB, cream tufted headboard #DBD8D1 and beige rug; close-ups use the fabric itself as ground; the dream frame uses high-key cloud sea #EAE2CD with pale gold sky #D3C3B3; never solid studio backdrops or cool blue rooms
style.direction: warm minimal family lifestyle bedding suite with a cloud-soft emotional motif: real bedrooms carry trust, close-ups carry craft, a high-key dream frame carries the peak
style.iconSystem: thin-line white icons on translucent circles for care claims, rounded callout cards with inset item photos, round certification badge only when a real certificate exists
style.lightingSystem: large-window diffuse soft light from front-left or rear-right, table-lamp warm accents allowed, always soft quality with deep soft shadows inside fabric folds and no hard cast shadows
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: warm minimal family bedding suite in slate gray #484651 brushed microfiber. Real bedrooms with warm white walls #D4CFCB, cream tufted headboard #DBD8D1 and soft window light carry the trust frames; fabric close-ups on deep charcoal-blue #33313C folds carry the craft frames; one high-key cloud-sea dream frame #EAE2CD with pale gold sky #D3C3B3 carries the softness peak. Large-window diffuse light only, deep soft shadows inside folds, never hard cast shadows. Rounded sans titles in white or warm brown #7F5C43, white translucent callout panels with dashed arrows for set anatomy, white line icons for care claims. One point per frame, bedding at least 55% of scene frames, generic people only, certificates and review counts only from verified facts.
noDrift: slate gray never drifts to pure gray or blue
no hard light or cold backgrounds
no brand names, barcodes or size-chart originals
no fabricated certificates or review counts
style.presentationRules: bedding occupies at least 55% in scenes and 90% in close-ups, one selling point per frame, titles never cover the product, people are always generic persons, proof numbers stay within verified facts
style.surfaceSystem: matte brushed microfiber with visible short-pile texture and rich draping folds, three cascading fold layers on the bed, large fabric waves allowed as foreground
style.temperature: warm neutral bright high-key, white balance warm but never yellow
style.typography: rounded geometric sans-serif; white titles on dark fabric or warm brown #7F5C43 on light walls, two-line titles top-centered or right third; annotations on white translucent rounded panels with dashed arrows; labels in white on dark folds
